s.md-9-> [!NOTE]\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-10->\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-11-> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI
6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. The
se versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.\n/workspace
/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-12-\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md:13:`mcpjam test <file>` runs an MCPJam suite file locally:
it connects your MCP servers, drives each case's prompts through a model, grades the transcript with the same assertions a hosted
run uses, and decides the run with the same verdict policy. Bring your own provider key and authenticate the run with MCPJam. With
MCPJam-hosted inference it uses your existing CLI login and billing.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-14-\n/workspace/mcpja
m-eval/local-evals.md-15-Results are **never uploaded**. The command writes results to your terminal and, if you ask, to a report
file. It records the run start with MCPJam. Like every command, it sends the CLI's single anonymous [telemetry](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/cli/telemetry.md) event, which `--no-telemetry` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1` turns off; the run adds no telemetry of its own.\n/works

pjam-eval/local-evals.md:136:There is no fallback: a key the provider rejects is a credential failure (exit `3`), never a reason t
o spend platform credits instead.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-137-\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-138-BYOK keys
are read from the standard variables: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` (or `GEMINI_API_KEY`)
, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, `MISTRAL_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`. `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `OLLAMA_
BASE_URL` point a provider at a gateway or proxy.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-139-\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.
md:140:MCPJam-hosted inference uses the Cloud credential precedence (`--api-key` > `MCPJAM_API_KEY` > `mcpjam cloud login`) and pr
oject precedence (`--project` > `MCPJAM_PROJECT` > `mcpjam cloud link` > most recently updated), plus `--api-url` / `--api-header`
. The platform is contacted only when a selected case needs it. Hosted inference still makes inference and billing requests; \"no
upload\" means no eval results or artifacts are ever sent.\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-141-\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/loc
al-evals.md-142-## Hosts\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-143-\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-144-`--host <template>
` emulates one existing host template — its `initialize` identity, advertised capabilities, protocol versions and tool visibility,
plus its model settings where the suite does not set them. It never launches the real client, and reports say \"emulated\". The s
uite's model, and any authored `systemPrompt` / `temperature`, win over the template's. `target.hosts` in the file is recorded as
declared but not executed, and `target.environment` as declared but not resolved.\n--\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-190-|

ge (including the hosted default) | Not run; the report says so |\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-192-| `suppressedSuiteSta
ndardCheckIds` | Refused — a local run has no suite-standard registry |\n/workspace/mcpjam-eval/local-evals.md-193-\n/workspace/mc
